stem: Match each structural requirement to its description.
solutionSteps: inclusiveness → the top class includes all subclasses
species/differentia → only the is-a relation between super- and subclass
inheritance → subclasses take on superclass attributes
transitivity → if A is a type of B and B of C, then A is a type of C
mutual exclusivity → an entity belongs to only one class
necessary and sufficient criteria → membership rules say what must be true and what is enough
systematic and predictable rules → grouping and distinguishing rules fixed beforehand
right: the top class includes all subclasses
membership rules say what must be true and what is enough
if A is a type of B and B of C, then A is a type of C
only the is-a relation between super- and subclass
an entity belongs to only one class
grouping and distinguishing rules fixed beforehand
